name: app-lavender-type-scale-and-flight-screens-with-airplane-photo
title: Type Scale, Flight Screens and Airplane Photo
whatItIs: A lavender page with a four-column type scale (Heading, Title, Body, Description) above three phones (flight search, flight details, seat selection) and a large airplane photo behind the lower phones.
whatItMeans: Pairing spec text with real screens and a dramatic photo keeps documentation lively and on theme.
techniques: Type spec rows above the visuals
Large photo tile behind overlapping phones
Seat map drawn in an aircraft outline

vocabulary.definition: Sizes and line heights listed per text role.
A diagram of selectable seats in a vehicle.
